caption: Will AI replace engineers? Wrong question. The real question is what you'll do with the hours it gives back.

slides.say: Everyone keeps asking if AI will replace engineers. That's the wrong question.
AI is great at writing code. But writing code was never the hard part.
The hard part is deciding what to build, and what to leave out.
The best teams use AI to test ideas faster, then spend the time they saved on thinking.

slides.screen: What will you do with the time?
slides.say: So don't ask if AI will replace you. Ask what you'll do with the hours it gives back. Follow for more.
